hero.eyebrow: A modern gurukul, for every district.
hero.title: Learn it. Teach it. Build it. Show it.
hero.sub: Synapse is a learning centre in Chamba that is growing into a three-floor place where students, graduates, readers and builders learn, teach and build together.
hero.strip: Small-group classes, Monday to Saturday, 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM, behind the Post Office, Chamba.

openNow.label: OPEN NOW
openNow.title: The Chamba Classroom
openNow.sub: Small groups, a guide who knows every student.
openNow.fee: Fees are shared when you enquire.
openNow.lead: Four tracks, five days a week per student. Fees are shared when you enquire. Every class ends with a practice test on what was just taught; doubts are solved in a separate short session.

theIdea.label: THE IDEA
theIdea.title: Three worlds that never meet, and the loop.
theIdea.problem: School gives a syllabus. Coaching gives exam technique. Innovation happens elsewhere. Nothing joins them.
theIdea.solution: Synapse puts learners, teachers and builders in one building so people take turns: learn it, teach it, build it, show it.
theIdea.analogy: AI is the encyclopaedia; Synapse is the gym and the workshop.

theBuilding.label: THE BUILDING
theBuilding.title: Three floors, built in order
theBuilding.sub: One building in Chamba growing floor by floor as each community proves itself.

fellowshipAndTools.label: FELLOWSHIP & TOOLS
fellowshipAndTools.title: Graduates who teach. Software that steps back.

fellowship.title: The Fellowship
fellowship.summary: Graduates preparing for an exam teach one class a day and get a library desk, certified teaching hours and the tutor for their own preparation. Applications are open now.

tutor.title: The Tutor (Corteon)
tutor.summary: Corteon gives hints before answers, asks how sure you are, and defers to a no-device quiz. In development.

passport.title: The Passport
passport.summary: A record the world can trust — an evidentiary portfolio, not a test paper.

principles.label: PRINCIPLES
principles.title: What we stand for
principles.sub: A child ends a term with marks and a body of work.

chooseDoor.label: CHOOSE YOUR DOOR
chooseDoor.title: Choose your door
chooseDoor.sub: The building welcomes people at every stage of learning and building. Select the door that fits you.

directContact.label: Direct Contact
directContact.text: Prefer to speak directly? Call or message the centre guide in Chamba.
